headline: Trump Vows Iran War 'Put Away Soon' as CENTCOM Readies Strikes
subheadline: Senior CENTCOM and IDF officials assess Trump could order renewed combat against Iran within days; missiles moved in Isfahan under IRGC escort.
lede: President Trump declared the Iran conflict will be 'put away' very soon, either through a deal or military action, after discussing Iran with Prime Minister Netanyahu Saturday. Senior CENTCOM and IDF officials assessed that Trump could order renewed combat against Iran within days, while Iranian missiles were transported in Isfahan under IRGC escort and jet activity was reported over Kermanshah. Simultaneously, Russia launched a massive Shahed and Geran-5 barrage lasting over 23 hours across at least ten Ukrainian oblasts, striking Rivne, the Kyiv-Boryspil area, and Kamianets-Podilskyi. Ukraine retaliated by hitting three Russian refineries accounting for approximately ten percent of national refining capacity, including the Lukoil facility in Kstovo.

sections.title: Russia Launches 23-Hour Multi-Axis Drone Offensive
sections.body: Russian Shahed and Geran-5 drones attacked for over 23 hours with launches from Kursk continuing beyond 28 hours, targeting at least ten oblasts including Kyiv, Rivne, Vinnytsia, and Kharkiv. Confirmed Geran-5 strikes hit Rivne city, the Kyiv-Boryspil area, and Kamianets-Podilskyi, while Black Sea-launched UAVs targeted Odesa, Mykolaiv, and Tatarbunary. A drone attack on Koziatyn in Vinnytsia region killed two civilians and injured three children, and a strike on Chernivtsi wounded a 67-year-old man. Ukraine responded by striking three Russian refineries representing roughly ten percent of refining capacity, including the Lukoil-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez plant in Kstovo.

sections.title: Trump Threatens Imminent Iran Military Action
sections.body: President Trump stated the Iran war will be 'put away' very soon, either by a deal or 'we just end it,' and confirmed discussing Iran with Prime Minister Netanyahu on Saturday. Senior CENTCOM and IDF officials assessed that Trump could order renewed combat against Iran within days, while two missiles were transported in Isfahan escorted by IRGC vehicles and jet activity was reported over Kermanshah. Meanwhile, Axios reported positive progress in U.S.-Iran talks in Qatar with the Iranian delegation departing Doha, though Foreign Minister Araqchi denied any planned meetings with the U.S. delegation. The Lebanon-Israel border recorded 208 alerts, 130 drone sightings, five air strikes, and 28 artillery shelling incidents on November 1.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The contradictory signals from Qatar — reported diplomatic progress versus Iran's denial of meetings and Trump's explicit military threat — create a volatile decision window for Washington. Senior U.S. and Israeli military coordination on strike timing, combined with visible Iranian missile movements, suggests operational preparations are advancing beyond signaling. In Ukraine, the unprecedented duration and geographic scope of the Russian drone campaign, paired with Kyiv's systematic refinery strikes, marks a qualitative escalation in the energy infrastructure war.
